hypothesis: Repo-wide maps and richer prompts will improve obligation-to-code mapping quality
experiment_setup: Iterative guided discovery flows over large repo context with narrative-heavy outputs
failure_signal: High narrative volume but weak per-obligation trust and difficult reproducibility
stop_condition: Could not keep row-level adjudication cost bounded with acceptable confidence
retained_lessons: More context does not monotonically improve trustable mappings; enforce narrower contracts

hypothesis: Layered guided steps will reduce drift while preserving coverage
experiment_setup: POC4_5 flow with staged discovery and mapping templates
failure_signal: Operational complexity and branchiness increased diagnosis burden
stop_condition: Workflow complexity exceeded practical replay/debug cost budget
retained_lessons: Prefer simpler phase boundaries with strict artifact lineage

approach_name: Multi-approach exploration for extraction and mapping
hypothesis: Broad approach exploration will identify strongest architecture before packaging
experiment_setup: Spike work across constants/guards/structural and decomposed patterns
failure_signal: Outputs became hard to compare without uniform adjudication contract
stop_condition: No common scoring frame to support reliable head-to-head conclusions
retained_lessons: Exploration is useful for discovery but not sufficient for production-trust decisions

hypothesis: Multiple specialized agents will increase correctness and robustness
experiment_setup: Proposal-era evaluation and design review matrix
failure_signal: High orchestration overhead and weak attribution clarity for failures
stop_condition: Cost/complexity not justified by evidence quality in current scope
retained_lessons: Single-agent phased pipeline remains easier to debug and audit

hypothesis: Augmented retrieval will reduce hallucinated references
failure_signal: Added moving parts and uncertain quality gains without benchmark proof
stop_condition: Insufficient evidence for reliable net trust improvement

hypothesis: Symbolic indexing will stabilize code-location mapping
failure_signal: Implementation complexity and maintenance overhead outpaced proven quality benefit
